You are a senior Spring Boot JWT security debugging agent. My Food Delivery Platform has JWT authentication working on user-service but ALL other services return 403 Forbidden when using the same JWT token.
Problem: user-service generates JWT tokens with its jwt.secret. But notification-service, restaurant-service, order-service, and payment-service each have their own jwt.secret that is DIFFERENT. So they cannot validate the token generated by user-service.
